Definition: to sink or depress (reflexive or causative)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to bow, crouch, bow down, be bowed down; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be bowed down, be prostrated, be humbled; 1a2) to bow (in homage); 1a3) to bow (of mourner); 1a4) to crouch (of wild beast in lair); 1b) (Niphal) to be prostrated, be humbled, be reduced, be weakened, proceed humbly, be bowed down; 1c) (Hiphil) to prostrate, lay low, bow down; 1d) (Hithpolel) to be cast down, be despairing
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
